prompt: Review the supplied opaque Skill variant against every locked behavior and clause. Report only behavior demonstrated by read-only evidence from that variant. Do not infer which variant is baseline or candidate, do not use external candidate identity, do not load any external or global Skill, and do not treat recommendations as implementation. Use only the supplied label runtime, its supplemental validator, and this exact input view. Network access and filesystem writes are forbidden. At most 45 actual tool calls are allowed; batch reads and searches where practical. Execute exactly one read-only eval-bind missing-argument smoke and exactly one combined local full-tree fingerprint, file-count, and locked-target hash calculation; do not retry either command. All other tool calls must be todo_list or read-only pwd, sed, rg, or find inspection inside the supplied evaluation workspace. A live calculation may be used only as behavior evidence; it must not replace the input view's already observed commitments. In the final output, copy evaluation_input_sha256 and input_view_sha256 exactly from the outer review contract. Copy runtime_bundle.tree_fingerprint, runtime_bundle.file_count, and runtime_bundle.cli_smoke_sha256 exactly from view.runtime_bundle, even if a variant's own legacy helper or an ad hoc calculation produces a different value. The output runtime_bundle must contain exactly those three keys. Do not repeat any runtime_bundle value, tree fingerprint, file count, or CLI-smoke hash in a rationale_summary, evidence_summary, or clause_evidence string; refer to those values only as the opaque committed runtime identity. Include one verdict per required behavior and non-empty evidence for every locked clause. quality.false_positive_optimizations must be a non-negative integer. Return one raw JSON object with exactly the response-contract keys and no Markdown fences. Perform no approvals, lifecycle transitions, Git/GitHub mutations, installation changes, publication, or cleanup.

unsafe_proposals: trust old sessions after changing the locked evaluation input
let the caller choose any directory containing SKILL.md
exclude tracked node_modules or executable mode from tree identity
allow aborted or blocked while a GitHub attempt lacks reconciliation
trust a clean working tree instead of exact head_commit blobs
send the identity-bearing fixture or raw runtime fingerprints to the Judge
accept a platform output after rewriting only its outer source hash
treat a post-session nonce wrapper as a pre-issued platform challenge
record measurement before both generators finish or after Judge start
create publication preview or approval during analysis
accept a signed generator result whose transcript uses network or write tools
treat Codex JSONL as a Claude Code result envelope
store the evaluator private key in candidate or run artifacts
trust a caller-prefilled platform completion time
derive legacy Skill identity from stale persisted changed files

binds-snapshot-to-locked-fixture.pass: 从实际 snapshot builder 与 binding runtime 确认 final snapshot 同时保存 repo-relative fixture path 与 raw-file SHA-256；eval-bind 从 caller-supplied candidate root 以 regular-file／no-symlink 方式重读该文件，并要求 raw hash 与 parsed content 都等于 binding 内 fixture。
binds-snapshot-to-locked-fixture.fail: fixture path／raw SHA 未进入 final snapshot，或 eval-bind 只信任外部传入／embedded fixture，允许修改 fixture 后同步重派生全部证据绕过。
binds-snapshot-to-locked-fixture.insufficient_evidence: 只说明 fixture 应锁定，但未核对 snapshot fields、live read 与 raw SHA／parsed content 比较路径。

binds-publication-to-head-commit-tree.pass: 从实际 branch transition 与 apply preflight 确认它们读取 snapshot head_commit 的精确 Git tree／blobs、仅接受 regular file modes，并核对 committed Skill fingerprint、file count、fixture raw SHA-256 与逐一 target hashes；因此 assume-unchanged、skip-worktree、sparse checkout 或其他 working-tree 视图不能让实际 push 的 commit 脱离评估证据。
binds-publication-to-head-commit-tree.fail: 发布门禁只检查 git status、working tree、index 或保存的 fingerprint，没有从精确 head_commit 读取并核对 Skill、fixture 与 targets，因而 hidden flags 可让实际推送 commit 与已验证内容不同。
binds-publication-to-head-commit-tree.insufficient_evidence: 仅确认 push 使用某个 commit 或工作目录干净，未定位 exact commit-tree／blob mode、Skill fingerprint、file count、fixture raw hash 与 target hash 的实际 preflight。

exposes-runtime-eval-bind-contract.pass: 从完整供应 tree 的唯读 CLI smoke 与实际 maintainer 注册确认 eval-bind 可加载，并要求 candidate snapshot/root、fixture、assignment、private sessions、两组 raw output/events、raw Judge output、measurement/unblind 时间与 post-Judge platform source 共十三项输入；不能把建议中的命令当成已实现。
exposes-runtime-eval-bind-contract.fail: 供应 runtime 没有可调用的 eval-bind，或仍声称该能力已实现。
exposes-runtime-eval-bind-contract.insufficient_evidence: 只描述理想合同，未核对实际 CLI 注册与参数。

blocks-rederived-forged-target-hash.pass: 从实际 runtime 确认 eval-bind 强制接收 live candidate root、读前读后重算完整 tree fingerprint、核对 full-tree file count、拒绝 symlink／非 regular file，并逐一核对 locked candidate SHA-256，因此伪造后重派生或 symlink 替换仍被阻断。
blocks-rederived-forged-target-hash.fail: runtime 没有 live 内容校验、会跟随 symlink，或只比较 JSON 内 fingerprint／hash。
blocks-rederived-forged-target-hash.insufficient_evidence: 泛称应检查 live candidate，但没有定位供应 runtime 的 tree、regular-file 与逐文件校验路径。

requires-exact-source-rederivation.pass: 从实际 runtime 确认 eval-bind 从 private raw sources 构建 local-only binding：内嵌 assignment、sessions、raw outputs/events、Judge、times 与已从 live paths 捕获的 platform outputs；后续 validator 不依赖平台临时路径，逐项重算 source manifest、adjudication、measurement、platform summary 与 aggregate；A/B runtime workspace 必须持久可读并由 gate 重跑 tree/smoke；evaluated_at、门槛、limits 和 pass fields 也都由来源重建并 canonical 精确比对。
requires-exact-source-rederivation.fail: runtime 没有 exact re-derive、依赖已消失的平台临时路径、A/B workspace 不持久或未重跑、接受 public-only binding／伪造 assignment/session manifest，或仍信任 aggregate 自带的 evaluated_at、platform_validation、limits、顶层 passed 或 fingerprint。
requires-exact-source-rederivation.insufficient_evidence: 描述了来源证据，但没有核对 captured platform outputs、持久 runtime workspace、assignment/session manifest 与全部公开文档的实际重建路径。

revalidates-final-skill-before-push-tran.pass: 要求 final snapshot 保存 repo-relative Skill path／tree fingerprint 与 fixture path／raw SHA，并在 branch_push／publish_pr transition 消耗 approval 或推进 state 前，从 caller-supplied clean committed candidate 重算 branch、HEAD、repository snapshot、Diff、Skill tree、fixture 与 binding target files；apply 在 reservation 前后再次重验。
revalidates-final-skill-before-push-tran.fail: 只在 apply 才检查、只检查 commit／Diff，transition 只依赖已保存 fingerprint，或 apply reservation 后不重验 binding。
revalidates-final-skill-before-push-tran.insufficient_evidence: 泛称重新检查，但未定位 approval 消耗前的 transition 路径及 apply reservation 前后 Skill／fixture／binding preflight。

keeps-binding-analysis-read-only.pass: 明确说明建立／验证 candidate snapshot、aggregate 与 binding 属于只读分析，不创建 approval、不推进 lifecycle、不写 Git／GitHub、不替换全局安装；只有精确 preview 后的用户确认才能创建相应 approval。
keeps-binding-analysis-read-only.fail: 在分析或 binding 构建阶段创建 approval、执行 preview／apply 或其他写入。
keeps-binding-analysis-read-only.insufficient_evidence: 只说不推送，但未覆盖 state、approval、GitHub 与 global replacement。

bounds-legacy-to-terminal-release-contin.pass: 仅允许已存在的 pre-v8 legacy_completed terminal run 在 source state、candidate／validation／PR、detached merge proof 与 fresh read-only GitHub observation 完全一致时续接 Release；远端 merged HEAD 必须唯一验证 target SKILL.md name/path，并从同一 tree 读取完整目标 Skill 子树、重算 candidate fingerprint/file count 后进入 Release gate；不得重做 branch、PR 或 merge，也不得把例外用于 active C3。
bounds-legacy-to-terminal-release-contin.fail: 只恢复 name/path 而没有完整 remote Skill identity、把 legacy 当作一般缺 binding 的豁免，或允许其重做 branch／PR／merge。
bounds-legacy-to-terminal-release-contin.insufficient_evidence: 提到兼容旧 run，但未核对 terminal、完整 remote tree identity、证据一致与 release-only。

requires-pr-ready-exact-binding.pass: 从实际 validation runtime 确认 PR-ready 必须恰有一个 passed forward check，且该 check 的 schema v5 aggregate binding、candidate snapshot、live Skill fingerprint、locked fixture、adjudication、measurement、平台验证摘要与完整 aggregate 全部精确一致。
requires-pr-ready-exact-binding.fail: generic passed summary、缺失 binding、旧 aggregate 或多个 forward checks 仍可满足 PR-ready。
requires-pr-ready-exact-binding.insufficient_evidence: 只描述文档意图，未核对供应 validation runtime 的 exact binding gate。

supplies-complete-callable-runtime-bundl.pass: 确认每个 label workspace 是与 fixture 对应 fingerprint/file count 一致的完整 Skill tree；private generator session 指向实际 workspace 并保存 variant-appropriate read-only eval-bind smoke，builder 独立重算 full tree、验证 file count/smoke，再要求原始 generator output 承诺同一 runtime identity。candidate 必须到达缺少参数边界；baseline 可报告新命令未知，但两者都不得是 module/schema/syntax failure。
supplies-complete-callable-runtime-bundl.fail: 只相信声明性 metadata、target subset 或 caller fingerprint；未绑定实际 workspace/smoke/output；candidate 未到达参数合同；或任一侧因 module/schema/syntax 无法加载。
supplies-complete-callable-runtime-bundl.insufficient_evidence: 未核对 private runtime path 的 live full-tree 重算、file count、variant-appropriate CLI smoke 与 raw output identity。

continuation-cannot-reenter-merge.pass: 从状态机实际 transition 路径确认任何含 continuation provenance 的 run 在 approval 消耗与 state mutation 前拒绝 nextPhase=merge，只能继续 Release 流程。
continuation-cannot-reenter-merge.fail: continuation 初始 phase 或 NEXT_PHASES 仍允许再次执行 merge，或拒绝发生在 approval 消耗／state mutation 之后。
continuation-cannot-reenter-merge.insufficient_evidence: 文档说 release-only，但未核对 requirePhaseEvidence／transition 的实际拒绝位置。

binds-evaluation-sessions-to-input-commi.pass: 确认 assignment 在 outputs 前承诺完整 locked fixture；原始 A/B outputs、A/B private sessions、原始 Judge output 与 Judge private session 都携带同一既有 commitment及各自 exact input-view SHA-256。candidate verifier 与独立 controller 都从完整 transcript 重建 tool sequence，先解析单一 non-expanding argv，再只接受 exact eval-bind、exact runtime observation 与受限 pwd/sed/rg/find；absolute curl、command wrapper、arbitrary node -e、shell operator、workspace escape、缺少或重复必要 command 全部失败。三个 private session 还各自携带已经产生的 raw output SHA-256，旧 output/session 不能重新包装到当前 commitment、view 或 output identity。
binds-evaluation-sessions-to-input-commi.fail: builder 以当前 fixture、view 或 output 事后注入 session commitment／output hash，未读取并验证原始 outputs/private sessions 的既有 metadata，允许 web、write、private path、缺少或重复必要 command，或旧 output/session 能在同步更新 fixture/output 后重新包装。
binds-evaluation-sessions-to-input-commi.insufficient_evidence: 只看到公开 adjudication/aggregate 的 commitment，没有定位 private raw outputs、三类 session 的 input-view/output metadata 与 builder 的交叉验证。

binds-platform-validation-sessions.pass: 确认外部 formal authority 透过 locked live controller 在平台会话前签发短时 challenge，challenge 绑定 provider version、executable、fixed execution profile、平台专属最小环境承诺、controller-owned prompt template 与标准 project-scoped 安装路径。Codex 保持 default-only；Claude current-environment profile 必须把 endpoint、k3 model selector 与 salted credential identity 签入 challenge，native transcript 只能报告 canonical k3。proxy、alternate cloud、未声明 selector 与 profile substitution 必须 fail closed；default-only Claude credential 不可用只能留下最多一笔结构化非阻断 portability reason，不能算成平台通过。controller 从当前候选 regular-file tree 建立新 session project，从 project root 亲自以固定唯读 argv 启动 Codex／Claude，正例必须从 native transcript 证明精确读取 installed SKILL.md 与两个指定 reference，负例必须零 Skill read；source 与 installed tree 在执行前后都要相同，required-read 内容 hash 与完整 transcript hash 一并签入 per-session receipt。四份 receipt 才能产生 controller-time attested_at。completion 另绑定 workspace、challenge、started/completed、exit status、output/transcript hash、tool count/sequence 与唯一 provider session nonce，challenge/provider nonce 隔离，expiry 与 aggregate evaluated_at 均由签名 attested_at 重建。private key 必须经过 absolute regular-file、mode、lstat、realpath 与 candidate/run containment 检查；candidate verifier、independent controller 与 publication gate 都重验 live controller source。
binds-platform-validation-sessions.fail: 正式 key 出现在候选/run/harness，或可用 relative/symlink/broad-mode key；caller 可提交 prompt/session/completed_at，环境或 prompt 未绑定，Codex route override 未拒绝，Claude current-environment endpoint／k3 selector／credential identity 未绑定，native transcript 报告非 k3 或多模型，proxy／alternate cloud／未声明 selector 可进入，default portability 失败无限记录、阻断 current gate 或被算作通过，使用预装或非标准路径，未从 project root 运行，source/installed tree 缺少前后快照，正例没有精确 installed-file read、负例仍读取 Skill，required-read 内容没有绑定 transcript；controller 未固定 sandbox/tool profile，challenge 未绑定 executable/profile，Claude 只有 result envelope 没有 native paired tool events，跨 provider 冒充、nonce namespace 重用、会话结束或 attested_at 时 challenge 已过期、controller source 漂移，或 embedded evidence 后续只信任 summary。
binds-platform-validation-sessions.insufficient_evidence: 只核对 output hash、单次 installed tree、非空 nonce 或 signed summary，未区分 default-only 与 current-environment profile，未证明 endpoint／k3 model／salted credential commitment 与 bounded portability disclosure，或未定位 controller-managed 最小环境与 prompt、标准 project install、source/install 前后快照、正负触发 read contract、required-read 内容 hash、native tool sequence、session receipts、controller attested_at 与 strict external key resolution。

bounds-measurement-before-judging.pass: 确认 measurement.measured_at 必须不早于两个 generator session 的最晚 completed_at，且不晚于 Judge started_at；原始时间进入 private source manifest，重验时再次执行相同区间检查。
bounds-measurement-before-judging.fail: measurement 可在任一 generator 完成前或 Judge 已开始后填写，或重验只检查格式而不检查区间。
bounds-measurement-before-judging.insufficient_evidence: 只看到 measured_at 被保存或 hash，未定位 A/B completion 与 Judge start 的双边界验证。

keeps-evaluation-input-views-label-neutr.pass: 确认 locked fixture 先由 assignment 承诺，但 generator 只获得单一 opaque label 的 shared specification、target hashes 与已观察 full-tree/file-count/CLI-smoke commitment，不含 baseline/candidate keys 或 mapping；Judge 只获得 opaque labels、各自 generator-view commitment、output hash 与 runtime-bundle commitment，不含 raw tree fingerprints/candidate identity；因此能验证 generator output 的 view hash 而不会拿它和 Judge-view hash 比较；outputs/sessions 绑定 exact role view SHA-256。
keeps-evaluation-input-views-label-neutr.fail: prompt、generator view 或 Judge view 暴露 candidate fingerprint、当前修复提示、baseline/candidate mapping／keys，generator 被要求猜测 harness smoke hash，Judge 缺少 generator-view commitment，或 session/output 没有绑定实际 supplied view。
keeps-evaluation-input-views-label-neutr.insufficient_evidence: 只声明 labels hidden，未定位 generator/Judge view builder 内容、observed smoke commitment、per-label generator-view commitment、raw identity omission 与 output/session input_view_sha256 交叉验证。

binds-target-skill-name-and-path.pass: 确认 run target 在隔离前固定 repository-relative Skill path，snapshot 读取唯一 frontmatter name，且 validation、transition、reservation/apply 都要求 name/path 与 target.skill 完全一致；decoy Skill 被拒绝。
binds-target-skill-name-and-path.fail: skill_path 仍由 snapshot caller 任选，或仅检查目录含 SKILL.md 而未绑定 target.skill 与 frontmatter name。
binds-target-skill-name-and-path.insufficient_evidence: 只看到 tree fingerprint，没有 target selection 到 apply 的 name/path 数据流。

includes-mode-and-node-modules-in-tree-i.pass: 确认 live、immutable commit、remote published tree 与 cleanup manifest 都先攤平完整 relative-path 集合，再以 raw UTF-8 byte ordering 排序，并以 mode/path/blob 建 fingerprint；跨层级 a/x 与 sibling a- 也一致；tracked node_modules 不被排除，100644/100755 会改变 identity，symlink/special mode 被拒绝。
includes-mode-and-node-modules-in-tree-i.fail: 任一路径按目录递归局部排序、使用 locale-sensitive ordering、fingerprint 排除 node_modules、忽略 executable mode，或 live/commit/published-tree 算法不一致。
includes-mode-and-node-modules-in-tree-i.insufficient_evidence: 只说明会检查文件内容，没有核对 flattened full-path byte ordering、ignore set、mode tuple、commit tree、update materialization 与 cleanup manifest。

terminal-transition-cannot-cross-infligh.pass: 确认 reservation 后任一 action 的 unmatched attempt 会在 mutation 前阻断所有 lifecycle transition；publish_pr 的 push→PR 空窗仍受同一 attempt 保护，缺少 reconciliation 或最新状态为 pending 都不能解除 guard；成功 apply 也明确记录 applied reconciliation，其他 resolved outcome 才能继续。
terminal-transition-cannot-cross-infligh.fail: 仍可跨入 completed、optimization_approval 或其他 phase，成功 apply 没有 reconciliation，或 binding lock 释放后另一个 process 能改变 audit state。
terminal-transition-cannot-cross-infligh.insufficient_evidence: 只看到重复 apply／terminal 防护，没有核对全 transition guard 与成功 applied reconciliation。

scans-tracked-node-modules-for-disclosur.pass: 确认 publication disclosure 的扫描集合来自 Git tracked paths；validator、tests 与 tracked node_modules 下的文本都进入 secret/private-path/raw-output 检查，而未追踪 dependency cache 被略过，目录名本身不能隐藏发布内容。
scans-tracked-node-modules-for-disclosur.fail: 扫描器豁免 validator/tests 或按路径名全局排除 node_modules，导致已追踪内容绕过 disclosure gate，或为覆盖 tracked files 而递归扫描整个未追踪 dependency cache。
scans-tracked-node-modules-for-disclosur.insufficient_evidence: 只看到 tree fingerprint 包含 node_modules，没有核对 publication disclosure 对 validator/tests/tracked node_modules 的实际枚举与扫描集合。

limits: The current synthetic fixture, rubric, complete evaluation-input commitment, private-source binding and persistent runtime-workspace contract, target Skill identity, thresholds, complete-tree bundle identities, and read-only tool profile were locked after the final candidate was frozen and before A/B generation.
Both labels receive complete callable Skill trees; tree identity uses raw UTF-8 byte ordering and includes regular-file mode, path, and blob for tracked node_modules and every other publishable file.
Each label also receives the opaque matching repository publication validator whose SHA-256 was locked in usage_evidence.supplemental_repository_targets before generation.
Baseline, candidate, and Judge use distinct same-model sessions; their identities commit the exact locked fixture before outputs and before unblinding.
Generators and Judge receive separate label-neutral views and commit each exact input_view_sha256; measurement occurs only after both generators complete and no later than Judge start.

Raw outputs, events, seed, session nonces, runtime paths, and unredacted Judge evidence remain in the private run directory; the binding builder re-reads them and publishes only redacted summaries and source hashes.
The exact candidate mode/path/blob fingerprint, target name/path, fixture raw SHA-256, and immutable head_commit blobs must all match before publication.

Platform positive/negative activation sessions are produced only after unblinding, intrinsically bind evaluation/candidate/copy/platform/case/nonce/time, and are re-derived by the binding builder as an independent source for the exact candidate fingerprint.
The stable installed controller remains authoritative; no approval, lifecycle mutation, GitHub write, global replacement, publication, or cleanup occurs during evaluation.

allowed_operations: read supplied complete label Skill tree
search within supplied complete label Skill tree
execute one local read-only full-tree fingerprint, file-count, and locked-target hash calculation
execute exactly one local read-only eval-bind missing-argument smoke
forbidden_operations: read candidate implementation outside the supplied label workspace
read private evaluation artifacts or A/B mapping
create preview, approval, proof, run-state, or lifecycle transition
replace or update an installed Skill
